role: MediaPipe Face Landmarker wrapper and deterministic mock for face detection and testing
detail: Provides MediaPipeFaceDetector (wraps Google MediaPipe Face Landmarker Tasks API, mediapipe >= 0.10) and MockFaceDetector (returns predetermined FaceDetection objects keyed by frame_sequence). MediaPipeFaceDetector processes RGB frames to return 478 face mesh landmarks in pixel coordinates, bounding boxes derived from landmark extremes, and optional blendshapes (52 facial expressions). Key functions: get_face_connections() returns CONTOURS topology (124 connections), get_face_oval_connections() returns FACE_OVAL topology (36 connections). Model path resolves to face_landmarker.task (~3.7 MB) relative to package root; detector internally runs up to 5 faces per frame with configurable confidence_threshold. Blendshapes extracted from MediaPipe output as dict[str, float]. Frame data validation ensures RGB bytes match width*height*3 exactly.
gotchas: Module lazily imports mediapipe inside __init__ to allow import without mediapipe installed (ImportError raised if missing at instantiation). Global caches _face_connections_cache and _face_oval_cache silently suppress exceptions during topology retrieval, returning empty lists on failure. Frame.data validation uses width*height*3 byte check but does not validate RGB format itself. Confidence score estimation falls back to config threshold rather than extracting from first blendshape. Model file download URL hardcoded in exception message.
